formulas.validation_score: net_return/max(max_drawdown,0.005)*sqrt(n/(n+100)); -1e12 if n<10 or net_return<=0 or unknown paths
formulas.CI95: 99999 fixed UTC-week block percentile bootstrap draws, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; insufficient if fewer than 100 trades or eight weeks
formulas.p: (1+count(centered week bootstrap null >= observed mean net_R))/100000
formulas.statistical_gate: mean_net_R CI95 lower>0 AND PF CI95 lower>1
formulas.financial_gates: n>=100, PF>=1.10, DD<=0.20, net_profit>0, net_return>costed B&H and native reference
formulas.WF_gate: three TESTED expanding development folds, each net_profit>0 and PF>=1.10; selection-dependent development stability only

scope_limits: Summaries and lineage matched; numerical recomputation is separately performed by root's final replay, not this review.
Financial counts describe fixed hypotheses; no final-outcome re-selection or promotion.
All 1300 primary policies are candle-executed assumption scenarios. Historical CFD costs/fills not verified.
Source retains an internal missing minute and an invalid off-grid original row per symbol; no interpolation.
Previously exposed historical prices do not constitute fresh prospective OOS evidence.
Only thirteen declared strategy families and 32 parameter rounds; no newly invented family each cycle.
